name: instahyre_auto_apply
prompt:
The script output above is the JSON summary from the Instahyre auto-apply run (instahyre_auto_apply.py). Do not run anything yourself; only format that output for WhatsApp.

If "applied" has entries:
✅ Applied:
- <title> @ <company> (<location>)

If "needs_review" has entries:
✋ Needs review:
- <title> @ <company> — <detail>

If "failed" has entries:
❌ Failed:
- <title> @ <company> — <detail>

End with one line: **Instahyre today: X applied, Y filtered**
Do not list filtered jobs individually, just the count.
If the output contains "INSTAHYRE_NOT_LOGGED_IN": tell Vishal the Instahyre session in the automation profile expired and needs a manual login.
If applied, needs_review and failed are all empty: respond with exactly [SILENT].
